name: ESO 208-G021 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 208-G021, a galaxy without an active nucleus, seen by Hubble.
label: eso208g021-hubble
story: ESO 208-G021 is a quiet stand-in for galaxies whose central black holes are actively feeding, chosen to match them in type and distance. Observations of its center found almost no molecular gas.

claims.text: ESO 208-G021 is an inactive control galaxy in the LLAMA sample, matched to the AGN in distance and Hubble type
CO was not detected in ESO 208-G021's center (upper limit only)
The galaxies in this program are AGN hosts and matched inactive control galaxies, imaged to balance an archive weighted toward the AGN
